bible_quanes.question: To what has God begotten us again?
bible_quanes.answer: A lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ

bible_quanes.question: What does God command in 1 Peter 1:16?
bible_quanes.answer: "Be holy, for I am holy"

bible_quanes.question: With what were we redeemed?
bible_quanes.answer: The precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish

bible_quanes.question: What endures for ever?
bible_quanes.answer: The word of the Lord

bible_quanes.question: To whom was 1 Peter written?
bible_quanes.answer: The strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia

bible_quanes.question: How is our inheritance described?
bible_quanes.answer: Incorruptible, undefiled, that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven

bible_quanes.question: To what is the genuineness of faith compared?
bible_quanes.answer: Gold tried with fire

bible_quanes.question: What do angels desire to look into?
bible_quanes.answer: The things of salvation

bible_quanes.question: When was Christ foreordained?
bible_quanes.answer: Before the foundation of the world

bible_quanes.question: What does 1 Peter 1:24 say all flesh is like?
bible_quanes.answer: Grass

bible_quanes.question: What are believers called in 1 Peter 2:9?
bible_quanes.answer: A chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people

bible_quanes.question: What should newborn babes desire?
bible_quanes.answer: The sincere milk of the word

bible_quanes.question: What did Christ bear in His own body on the tree?
bible_quanes.answer: Our sins
bible_quanes.explanation: By His stripes you were healed.

bible_quanes.question: What does 1 Peter 2:17 command?
bible_quanes.answer: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king

bible_quanes.question: What are believers being built up as?
bible_quanes.answer: A spiritual house, a holy priesthood

bible_quanes.question: What is laid in Zion?
bible_quanes.answer: A chief corner stone, elect, precious

bible_quanes.question: What did Christ leave us?
bible_quanes.answer: An example, that we should follow His steps

bible_quanes.question: What is Christ called in 1 Peter 2:25?
bible_quanes.answer: The Shepherd and Bishop of your souls

bible_quanes.question: What does Peter call his readers in 1 Peter 2:11?
bible_quanes.answer: Strangers and pilgrims

bible_quanes.question: What did Christ do when reviled?
bible_quanes.answer: He reviled not again, but committed Himself to Him that judgeth righteously

bible_quanes.question: What should we always be ready to give?
bible_quanes.answer: An answer to every man that asketh a reason of the hope that is in you

bible_quanes.question: Why did Christ suffer once for sins?
bible_quanes.answer: That He might bring us to God

bible_quanes.question: What is of great worth in the sight of God?
bible_quanes.answer: A meek and quiet spirit

bible_quanes.question: What should we not return for evil?
bible_quanes.answer: Evil

bible_quanes.question: How may unbelieving husbands be won?
bible_quanes.answer: By the conversation of the wives

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Sarah call "lord"?
bible_quanes.answer: Abraham

bible_quanes.question: How should husbands dwell with their wives?
bible_quanes.answer: According to knowledge, giving honour as heirs together of the grace of life

bible_quanes.question: How many souls were saved in Noah's ark?
bible_quanes.answer: Eight

bible_quanes.question: What does baptism now save us as?
bible_quanes.answer: The answer of a good conscience toward God

bible_quanes.question: What are the eyes of the Lord on?
bible_quanes.answer: The righteous
bible_quanes.explanation: His ears open to their prayers.

bible_quanes.question: What will love cover?
bible_quanes.answer: A multitude of sins

bible_quanes.question: How should each one use his gift?
bible_quanes.answer: Minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God

bible_quanes.question: How should we view the fiery trial?
bible_quanes.answer: Not as though some strange thing happened

bible_quanes.question: What should one not be if he suffers as a Christian?
bible_quanes.answer: Ashamed

bible_quanes.question: What should we arm ourselves with?
bible_quanes.answer: The same mind as Christ who suffered in the flesh

bible_quanes.question: What is at hand?
bible_quanes.answer: The end of all things

bible_quanes.question: How should we be hospitable?
bible_quanes.answer: Without grudging

bible_quanes.question: Where must judgment begin?
bible_quanes.answer: At the house of God
bible_quanes.explanation: What will be the end of the disobedient?

bible_quanes.question: How should one speak?
bible_quanes.answer: As the oracles of God

bible_quanes.question: What did the readers do in time past?
bible_quanes.answer: Walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings and idolatries

bible_quanes.question: What should we cast on God?
bible_quanes.answer: All your care; for he careth for you

bible_quanes.question: How does the devil walk about?
bible_quanes.answer: Like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour

bible_quanes.question: Whom does God give grace to?
bible_quanes.answer: The humble

bible_quanes.question: What will we receive when the Chief Shepherd appears?
bible_quanes.answer: A crown of glory that fadeth not away

bible_quanes.question: How should elders shepherd the flock?
bible_quanes.answer: Not by constraint but willingly, not for filthy lucre but of a ready mind

bible_quanes.question: What should we humble ourselves under?
bible_quanes.answer: The mighty hand of God

bible_quanes.question: How should we resist the devil?
bible_quanes.answer: Stedfast in the faith

bible_quanes.question: By whom did Peter write?
bible_quanes.answer: Silvanus

bible_quanes.question: Which city sends greetings in 1 Peter 5:13?
bible_quanes.answer: Babylon

bible_quanes.question: Whom does Peter call his son?
bible_quanes.answer: Marcus
